nodes.label: Cosine Similarity distance metric
nodes.rationale: Best for normalized vectors / semantic similarity / text embeddings; default metric.

nodes.label: Euclidean Distance (L2) metric
nodes.rationale: Best for spatial data, image embeddings, computer vision where magnitude matters.

nodes.label: Dot Product metric
nodes.rationale: Best for pre-normalized embeddings, fast similarity computation.

nodes.label: Hybrid Search (Vector + Metadata)
nodes.rationale: Combines vector similarity with metadata filters ($gte, $in, $contains) and weighted hybrid scoring.

nodes.label: Multi-Database Management / Sharding
nodes.rationale: Separate DBs per domain or shards routed via getDBForDomain for horizontal scaling.

nodes.label: MMR (Maximal Marginal Relevance)
nodes.rationale: mmrLambda balances relevance vs diversity for non-redundant search results.

nodes.label: Context Synthesis (synthesizeContext)
nodes.rationale: ContextSynthesizer generates coherent narrative + extracted patterns from multiple retrieved memories.
